req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-038 requires that PUT /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 422 when called without a request body. The actual endpoint in the source is PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Three test cases are designed: (1) NEG — send PUT with no body at all, expect 422; (2) EP positive — send PUT with a valid body for an existing player, expect 204 (confirms the route works normally, killing mutations that always return 422); (3) BVA boundary — send PUT with an empty JSON object {} (body present but missing required fields), expect 422. Together these cover the error pathway, the happy path, and the boundary between 'no body' and 'invalid body', maximising mutation kill rate by asserting exact status codes on both sides of the validation gate.

preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Messi)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel JSON body matching squad_number=10
trace: R-PLAYER-038: confirms the positive path returns 204, killing mutations that always return 422 or that flip the status code constant
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 204

test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204()

Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Messi)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with an empty JSON object {} as the body (body is present but contains no fields)
expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity is returned because required fields (first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) are missing
trace: R-PLAYER-038: boundary between 'no body' (422) and 'valid body' (204); empty object is the minimal body that still fails validation

    )
    assert response.status_code == 422
    body = response.json()
    assert "detail" in body

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_response_contains_detail():
    response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1")
    assert response.status_code == 422
    body = response.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) > 0

tests.name: test_put_player_partial_body_missing_required_fields_returns_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Messi)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a body that contains only optional fields (no required fields like first_name, last_name, position, squad_number)
expected: Response status code is exactly 422, not 204 or 400
trace: R-PLAYER-038: boundary — body present but required fields absent still triggers 422; catches mutations that change the validation logic or status code

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_partial_body_missing_required_fields_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.status_code != 204
    assert response.status_code != 400

test_put_player_partial_body_missing_required_fields_returns_422()
